## Included material

- The specification in `FLOOR.md`, the schema in `schemas/`, and the calculation
  and example vectors in `vectors/`.
- The implementation in `peaches_book/` and its tests in `tests/`.
- The first-party README, root project documentation and project-authored JSON
  records identified in the [adoption record](licensing/adoption-2026-10-05.json).
- Package, build, development and CI configuration, including `pyproject.toml`,
  `requirements-dev.txt`, `.gitattributes`, `.gitignore` and `.github/workflows/`.
- This coverage notice, `NOTICE`, and the dated licence-adoption record.

The adoption record lists the 31 reviewed first-party files and their hashes at
the identified pre-adoption commit. This grant also covers their accompanying
licensing and package-metadata updates. Those hashes preserve the review point;
they do not make later revisions of these first-party files unlicensed.

The older TestBook/SQLite implementation is included as code. Its existing
experimental status remains unchanged; licensing it does not make it part of the
Floor protocol or a required registry. Draft and historical documents retain
their recorded status.
